question: Based on the World Bank global population dataset and the World Bank health nutrition population dataset, how many countries experienced an increase of more than 1% from the previous year to 2018 in both their total population and per capita current health expenditure (PPP)?
sql:
WITH pop AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code,
    year_2017 AS pop_2017,
    year_2018 AS pop_2018,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(year_2018 - year_2017, year_2017) * 100 AS pop_growth_pct
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_global_population.population_by_country`
  WHERE year_2017 IS NOT NULL AND year_2018 IS NOT NULL AND year_2017 > 0
),
health AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2017 THEN value END) AS health_2017,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2018 THEN value END) AS health_2018,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2018 THEN value END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2017 THEN value END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2017 THEN value END)
    ) * 100 AS health_growth_pct
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.health_nutrition_population`
  WHERE indicator_code = 'SH.XPD.CHEX.PP.CD' AND year IN (2017, 2018)
  GROUP BY country_code
),
agg_codes AS (
  SELECT 'AFE' AS country_code UNION ALL
  SELECT 'AFW' UNION ALL SELECT 'ARB' UNION ALL SELECT 'CEB' UNION ALL SELECT 'CSS' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'EAP' UNION ALL SELECT 'EAR' UNION ALL SELECT 'EAS' UNION ALL SELECT 'ECA' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'ECS' UNION ALL SELECT 'EMU' UNION ALL SELECT 'EUU' UNION ALL SELECT 'FCS' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'HIC' UNION ALL SELECT 'HPC' UNION ALL SELECT 'IBD' UNION ALL SELECT 'IBT' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'IDA' UNION ALL SELECT 'IDB' UNION ALL SELECT 'IDX' UNION ALL SELECT 'LAC' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'LCN' UNION ALL SELECT 'LIC' UNION ALL SELECT 'LMC' UNION ALL SELECT 'LMY' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'MEA' UNION ALL SELECT 'MIC' UNION ALL SELECT 'NAC' UNION ALL SELECT 'PSS' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'SAS' UNION ALL SELECT 'SSF' UNION ALL SELECT 'SST' UNION ALL SELECT 'TEA' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'TEC' UNION ALL SELECT 'TLA' UNION ALL SELECT 'TMN' UNION ALL SELECT 'TSA' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'TSS' UNION ALL SELECT 'UMC' UNION ALL SELECT 'WLD'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS country_count
FROM pop p
JOIN health h ON p.country_code = h.country_code
LEFT JOIN agg_codes a ON p.country_code = a.country_code
WHERE a.country_code IS NULL
  AND p.pop_growth_pct > 1 
  AND h.health_growth_pct > 1
